verdict.rationale: AutoGen ships a built-in AssistantAgent, an LLM-backed agent that can use tools, and you delegate work to it directly with `agent.run(task=...)`. AutoGen Studio adds an interactive environment for running agent teams, with pause and stop control. Missing for 10: a ready-to-use in-product assistant that needs no code or model-client setup, and independent hands-on corroboration that task delegation works well (the one community report on output quality is mixed).
